grammar_title: 省略(Ellipsis):不定式的省略 · 状语从句的省略 · 对话/并列句中重复成分的省略
source: 人教版2019必修三 Unit 3 Discovering Useful Structures:Understand the use of ellipsis in English。每题留一处 ____,只有一个选项能地道地还原/补全省略结构,干扰项为错连词、错动词形式或多余成分。句子地道、答案唯一。

points.point: 不定式的省略(保留 to,省略后面的动词原形)
points.overview: 当不定式所表达的动作在上文已出现时,常只保留 to,省略其后的动词(及宾语):—Will you join us? —I'd love to. / You can go if you want to. / I didn't mean to. 若动词为 be/完成体 have,则保留 to be / to have。

points.point: 状语从句的省略(连词 + V-ing / V-ed / adj,省略“主语 + be”)
points.overview: 当状语从句的主语与主句主语一致(或为 it)且谓语含 be 时,可省略“主语 + be”,只留连词 + 现在分词/过去分词/形容词/介词短语:When (you are) in Rome, do as the Romans do. / If (it is) necessary, call me. / Though (he was) tired, he kept working.

points.point: 对话/并列句中重复成分的省略(省主语、助动词、重复谓语等)
points.overview: 为避免重复,对话答语或并列句中常省去与上文相同的成分,只保留新信息或助动词/be/情态动词:—Where are you going? —(I'm going) To the library. / He can swim, and so can I. / She likes tea, but I don't (like tea).

questions.stem: —Will you come to the ethnic festival with us? —I'd love ____.
questions.explanation: 上文已有 come,不定式只保留 to,省略后面的动词。

questions.stem: You can visit Chinatown today if you really want ____.
questions.explanation: want 后接不定式,动作上文已提,只保留 to。

questions.stem: —I'm sorry I stepped on your foot. —Don't worry, you didn't mean ____.
questions.explanation: mean to do,动作已知,只留 to。

questions.stem: She didn't buy the souvenir, though she had hoped ____.
questions.explanation: hope to do,buy 已出现,保留 to 省略动词。

questions.stem: —Why didn't you taste the gumbo? —I wanted ____, but it was all gone.
questions.explanation: want to do,taste 上文已现,只留 to。

questions.stem: He doesn't practise tai chi every day, but he used ____.
questions.explanation: used to do 表过去习惯,动词省略只保留 to。

questions.stem: —Could you show me the Dragon Gate? —I'd be glad ____.
questions.explanation: be glad to do,动作已知,保留 to。

questions.stem: I haven't tried the spicy stew yet, but I'm going ____ tonight.
questions.explanation: be going to do,try 已提,留 to 省略动词。

questions.stem: —Have you booked the trip to Guizhou? —Not yet, but I plan ____ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: plan to do,book 上文已现,保留 to。

questions.stem: You needn't taste every dish unless you'd like ____.
questions.explanation: would like to do,taste 已知,只留 to。

questions.stem: —Will Justin join the village tour? —He'd really like ____.
questions.explanation: would like to do,join 已现,保留 to。

questions.stem: I didn't write the travel journal myself, though I ought ____.
questions.explanation: ought to do,write 已知,保留 to。

questions.stem: —Did you climb to the waterfall cave? —I tried ____, but it was too steep.
questions.explanation: try to do,climb 上文已现,只留 to。

questions.stem: —You should taste the fortune cookie. —I'm just about ____.
questions.explanation: be about to do,taste 已知,保留 to 省略动词。

questions.stem: She wanted to buy the herbal medicine but wasn't allowed ____.
questions.explanation: be allowed to do,buy 已现,只留 to。

questions.stem: —Will you record his story for the journal? —Sure, I'm happy ____.
questions.explanation: be happy to do,record 已知,保留 to。

questions.stem: He hasn't moved to the Mission District yet, but he hopes ____ soon.
questions.explanation: hope to do,move 上文已现,留 to。

questions.stem: —Are you going to learn the lusheng? —Yes, I really intend ____.
questions.explanation: intend to do,learn 已现,保留 to。

questions.stem: I didn't explore the whole museum, although I'd planned ____.
questions.explanation: plan to do,explore 已知,只留 to。

questions.stem: —Could you carry these souvenirs for me? —Of course, I'd be glad ____.
questions.explanation: be glad to do,carry 已现,保留 to。

questions.stem: When ____ in Rome, do as the Romans do.
questions.explanation: 状语从句省略“主语 + be”,只留连词加介词短语:When (you are) in Rome。

questions.stem: If ____ necessary, please call your guide for help.
questions.explanation: If (it is) necessary,省略“it is”,只留形容词 necessary。

questions.stem: Though ____ tired, the travellers kept walking through Chinatown.
questions.explanation: Though (they were) tired,省略“主语 + be”,留过去分词 tired。

questions.stem: While ____ in Guizhou, Justin met many friendly local people.
questions.explanation: While (he was) travelling,省略“he was”,留现在分词 travelling。

questions.stem: When ____ from the hill, the Golden Gate Bridge looks amazing.
questions.explanation: When (it is) seen,被动省略留过去分词 seen。

questions.stem: Unless ____ to do so, visitors should not touch the old china plates.
questions.explanation: Unless (they are) asked,被动省略留过去分词 asked。

questions.stem: Once ____ with cheese, the corn chips become tasty nachos.
questions.explanation: Once (they are) covered,被动省略留过去分词 covered。

questions.stem: If ____ for advice, ask a local about the best ethnic restaurants.
questions.explanation: If (it is) possible,省略“it is”,留形容词 possible。

questions.stem: Although ____ as a poor area, the Mission District is now a centre for art.
questions.explanation: Although (it is) known,被动省略留过去分词 known。

questions.stem: When ____ a foreign city, try to learn a little of its local culture.
questions.explanation: When (you are) visiting,省略“you are”,留现在分词 visiting。

questions.stem: Whenever ____ in doubt about a word, just ask politely.
questions.explanation: Whenever (you are) in doubt,省略“you are”,留介词短语。

questions.stem: While ____ at street art, Li Lan spent a few happy hours in the district.
questions.explanation: While (she was) looking,省略“she was”,留现在分词 looking。

questions.stem: If ____, the hand-made silver accessories make wonderful souvenirs.
questions.explanation: If (they are) wanted,被动省略留过去分词 wanted。

questions.stem: Though ____ small, the village shows a rich ethnic minority culture.
questions.explanation: Though (it is) small,省略“it is”,留形容词 small。

questions.stem: When ____ for the first time, the lusheng music sounds quite unusual.
questions.explanation: When (it is) heard,被动省略留过去分词 heard。

questions.stem: While ____ his trip, Justin took many photos of the waterfall.
questions.explanation: While (he was) enjoying,省略“he was”,留现在分词 enjoying。

questions.stem: If ____ carefully, the diverse culture of China is easy to appreciate.
questions.explanation: If (it is) studied,被动省略留过去分词 studied。

questions.stem: Although ____ from China, the gate's materials were used to build it locally.
questions.explanation: Although (they were) donated,被动省略留过去分词 donated。

questions.stem: When ____ about Chinatown, most visitors first mention its food.
questions.explanation: When (they are) asked,被动省略留过去分词 asked。

questions.stem: While ____ at the potluck dinner, we shared dishes from many cultures.
questions.explanation: While (we were) eating,省略“we were”,留现在分词 eating。

questions.stem: —Where are you heading this evening? —____ Chinatown.
questions.explanation: 答语省略“I'm heading to”,只留新信息,介词 To 起头。

questions.stem: Justin loves the ethnic villages, and ____ does Linlin.
questions.explanation: “so + 助动词 + 主语”表示后者也如此:so does Linlin。

questions.stem: —I just love these nachos! —____ do I.
questions.explanation: 肯定附和用“So do I”,省去重复的谓语 love them。

questions.stem: She has visited Chinatown, but I ____.
questions.explanation: 省略重复谓语,只留助动词:but I haven't (visited it)。

questions.stem: —Have you ever heard of Journey to the West? —Yes, I ____.
questions.explanation: 用助动词代替整个谓语:Yes, I have (heard of it)。

questions.stem: —Who wants to try the fortune cookie? —____ do!
questions.explanation: 答语省略重复谓语,只留主语加助动词:I do!

questions.stem: —What a real mix of cultures here! —____ it is!
questions.explanation: 附和上句用“So it is”,省略 a real mix of cultures。

questions.stem: Linlin can speak the local dialect, and ____ can her brother.
questions.explanation: “so + can + 主语”表后者也能:so can her brother。

questions.stem: —Did you enjoy the waterfall? —Yes, I ____, very much.
questions.explanation: 用助动词 did 代替 enjoyed it,省略重复谓语。

questions.stem: He didn't taste the spicy stew, and ____ did I.
questions.explanation: 否定附和用“neither + did + 主语”:neither did I。

questions.stem: —Are you going to the jazz bar tonight? —Yes, I ____.
questions.explanation: 用 be 动词代替整个谓语:Yes, I am (going)。

questions.stem: —Would you recommend the museum? —I certainly ____.
questions.explanation: 用情态动词 would 代替 recommend it,省略重复谓语。

questions.stem: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous, and some ____ not.
questions.explanation: 并列句省略 poisonous,只留 be 动词:some are not。

questions.stem: —Can you wait a moment? —____ wait.
questions.explanation: 口语省略主语 I,只留助动词:Can't wait!(= I can't wait)。

questions.stem: She likes Cantonese food, but her friend ____.
questions.explanation: 省略重复谓语 like it,只留助动词:but her friend doesn't。

questions.stem: —Is the climate mild here? —Yes, it ____.
questions.explanation: 用 be 动词代替整个谓语:Yes, it is (mild)。

questions.stem: I have been to Yunnan, but my sister ____.
questions.explanation: 完成时省略重复谓语,只留助动词:but my sister hasn't。

questions.stem: —So it's the food of many cultures, all in one dish? —____.
questions.explanation: 答语用一个词 Exactly 代替整句,省略重复内容。

questions.stem: —Will the villagers perform a dance? —I hope ____.
questions.explanation: hope so 用 so 代替前面整句,省略重复内容。

questions.stem: Justin took lots of photos, and ____ did his friends.
questions.explanation: “so + did + 主语”表后者也如此:so did his friends。
